name: Winona Camps for Boys
description_short: A traditional boys' sleepaway camp on Moose Pond in Bridgton, founded in 1908, for boys 7 to 15. Campers live in canvas tents, learn outdoor living skills and go on canoe and mountain trips, plus activities like sailing, rock climbing, kayaking and lacrosse. Full season or either half.
